lede: Wednesday's web had one story jumping feeds at once: three supporting acts quit Ed Sheeran's tour after Macklemore was dropped over comments on Palestine, a fight that surfaced on both Bluesky and Lemmy the same day. The same saga pulled Robert Kraft into frame and sent his Wikipedia page to 156,382 views. Away from the noise, Alibaba's open-code-review topped GitHub trending with 2,756 stars in a day, and Monster Hunter Wilds held the evening on Steam with 42,617 concurrent players.
